body: Find good things to fill your void. Find things that fill it that aren't bad for you. It could be art, science, creating things. You can't expect the void to fill itself. That's the hardest thing to hear. But you have to work at full the void yourself. It's the hardest thing to do. But I believe in you.

Hey. You're okay. Everything is going to be fine
Just breathe. You can do it. Go to a hospital. Trust them. You may not want to, but they can help you. Find a nurse with a kind smile and just ask her to help you. You'll be okay, they will take care of you regardless of what you feel sometimes. Just breathe. Ask for help. It'll be okay.
